concept_images.review: World/Base/Flange/TCP labels and relationships checked; illustrative robot is not the Elfin05 DH model.

Five labels and forward arrows verified. Downsampling retains isolated points; filtering removes them. Normals denote local directions and transform retains the surface shape. Conceptual sketches are not measured point counts.
Verified overlapping brackets S,M then M,C; shared M preserved; remove S and append C. Bottom sentence avoids confusing state symbols with partial observations.
Blue arrow corrected to originate at Left Q=2, purple arrow from Right Q=5. Arithmetic 0.8/3.5 and terminal reward-only targets checked; behavior and bootstrap choices distinguished.

U opening is white/open upward in original and three-piece union; middle convex hull fills it. Removed sequential arrows so no inverse reconstruction from filled hull is implied. Three ideal rectangles, not algorithm output.

calibration_counterexample.scope: Separate binary probability fixture; not a transformation of routing scores.

wilson_arithmetic_example.assumption: Hypothetical independent Bernoulli trials, not an interval claim for these constructed records.

ddim.json.scope: Oracle algebra and error propagation only; no trained denoiser, FID or model-quality comparison.

checks: future valid-key invariance for the first query
cache-mask.json.scope: Attention operator only; no positional embedding, transformer layers, generation benchmark or fused GPU-kernel claim.

stiffness.json.scope: Rigid 2R links, joint springs, zero preload, first-order statics; separate scalar gain update at fixed position and zero velocity. No closed-loop passivity guarantee.

external-wrench.json.scope: Exact model consistency, including a rotated and offset tool frame. No sensor, actuator tracking, friction, acceleration estimation or observer validation.

kinematics-gradient.json.scope: Two bounded revolute joints and one fixed tool; position FK derivatives and yaw geometric Jacobian. Does not differentiate through IK or calibrate URDF parameters.

dual-abi.json.scope: One std::string-returning function across two translation units. No shared-library replacement, GLIBCXX version failure, cross-compiler compatibility claim or application ABI audit.

qt_essential_modules.display_mode: offscreen; not a native desktop display test

meshcat.transport: recording sink; no HTTP, WebSocket or ZeroMQ server started

filter-final.log.tests: normalization, literal/AND matching, sorting, immutability, URL state, exact coverage passed
